description: Source file implementing a sample XMLRPC client for executing test case results in the TestLink API. It constructs and sends an RPC call with test execution data, including context and result information.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard class used to create generic objects for context and execution data.

classes.name: IXR_Client

methods.description: Constructs and executes an XMLRPC call to report a test case result, given server URL, context, execution data, and debug flag.
